summary: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing outstanding Form 10-Qs for the quarters ended March 31 and June 30, 2026. The company received confirmation from Nasdaq on September 2, 2026, that it is back in compliance with all listing standards. This is a routine regulatory compliance update following the curing of a filing delinquency. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or material corporate event is involved. The filing is informational only and does not trigger any special-situations category.
